thread:
sam_support: Heads-up — Nimbus AP flagged invoice 2026-03-09-NIM as rejected. Their ERP reports PO mismatch: our invoice PO=7701 but their system expects PO=7700. They also say VAT treatment is wrong and are asking for Net 30.
maria_support: Can you paste the ERP error or a screenshot? Any attached invoice PDF?
sam_support: They pasted: "ERR_INV_PO_MISMATCH: PO(7701) != PO_EXPECTED(7700)". Screenshot shows VAT charged. They attempted to edit payment terms in Console and got a 502 gateway error.
alexa_engineer: Checked billing-api logs for 2026-03-09T14:05Z. PUT /v1/customers/nimbus/billing returned 502 upstream read timeout. Stack trace snippet: 
```
BillingApiClient.java:312 TimeoutException: upstream read timeout
 at io.netty.handler... (truncated)
```
We also saw brief load on cluster-bill-04 around that minute.
devon_billing: For reverse-charge VAT we need their VAT number on file; invoice must show VAT=0 and include note "reverse charge". If VAT is populated our emitter marks it VAT-charged and their AP will reject. Do we have their VAT ID?
maria_support: They provided an EU VAT number in the ticket: IE3456789X. I uploaded it to the account and attached their procurement email confirming PO 7700.
bot_invoices: invoice-service: reissue queued for invoice 2026-03-09-NIM  validation error: PO mismatch  awaiting manual reissue.
jon_sales: Nimbus is asking Net 30 but their procurement usually negotiates Net 60 for enterprise deals. Sales: is Net 30 within our delegation for this account?
erin_finance: Quick review (acct 6602): domestic credit limit 120k, no recent delinquencies. Net 30 is within policy for this tier and ARR profile. Net 60 requires VP finance sign-off. We can provisionally permit Net 30 pending signed PO/SOW. Also finance will allow a 7-day service-stay if they provide a $1 auth or a partial payment.
sam_support: Customer says procurement can't sign immediately (~48h) but they can confirm PO 7700 via procurement email — they need the invoice to show PO 7700 to pass AP automation. They asked if we can reissue now and annotate terms as Net 30.
devon_billing: Reissue API expects parameters: invoice_id, po, vat_id, vat_mode. Example we call internally: 
```
POST /internal/reissue
{
  "invoice_id": "2026-03-09-NIM",
  "po": "7700",
  "vat_id": "IE3456789X",
  "vat_mode": "reverse_charge"
}
```
Important: do NOT flip the account-level payment term until finance finalizes. Instead add an invoice note: "Payment terms: pending Net 30 approval".
alexa_engineer: I can run a dry-run reissue now that procurement email is attached. If the billing-api 502 returns I'll retry with exponential backoff; aim for dry-run -> finalize within a 15m window.
jon_sales: I'll follow up with procurement to request signature within 48h and confirm they sent the procurement email used here. I'll also ask them to authorize a $1 auth to prevent service interruption.
erin_finance: Approved to reissue with PO=7700 and VAT reverse-charge annotation under approval REF FIN-2026-419. We will finalize Net 30 upon receipt of signed PO/SOW within 72h and if credit check remains clear.
maria_support: Executed reissue. invoice-service returned success. New invoice id 2026-03-09-NIM-v2 with PO=7700, VAT marked "reverse_charge" and note "Payment terms: pending Net 30 approval (FIN-2026-419)". Notifying customer now. :white_check_mark:
sam_support: Nimbus confirmed their ERP accepted the reissued invoice and moved it to AP queue. They will upload the signed PO/SOW within 72h. Leaving thread open until docs received. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
